134efa6c7ad9e221.description: Real estate in India runs on WhatsApp forwards, spreadsheets and memory. The same property is shared by a dozen people, buyers get lost in chats, and good deals never meet the right buyer. We're building the platform where India's real-estate professionals work and connect, backed by more than 20 years of brokerage experience in Gurugram and NCR. The product is already built: a large, production-grade TypeScript codebase spanning a web app, iOS and Android apps, an API and dozens of background services. Now we're growing the team that takes it to market. ### The role You'll be the second engineer on the team, working day to day with our founding engineer and directly with the founder. You'll ship real features every week across web, mobile and the API, with your code reviewed by someone who knows the system end to end. This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow fast: real ownership, a product heading to market, and a codebase that rewards care. ### What you'll do - **Build features end to end:** the screen, the API route, the database query and the background job behind it. - **Build mobile screens** in React Native with Expo, alongside the web version of the same flow. - **Make every screen complete:** loading, empty, error and permission states, on phone and desktop widths. - **Build internal tools** for moderation, verification and operations. - **Fix bugs and performance issues,** and trace a problem from the UI down to the query that causes it. - **Work with AI coding agents** as a daily tool, and own every line that ships: you can explain and debug what you merge. - **Keep the bar high:** type-safe code that passes our checks, clear commits, and pull requests a reviewer can follow. ### Our stack - **Language & tooling:** TypeScript (strict), Bun - **Web:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TanStack Query, Table & Form, Zustand, Motion - **Mobile:** Expo, React Native, Expo Router, Reanimated, HeroUI Native, FlashList - **API & auth:** ElysiaJS with an end-to-end typed client, better-auth, Zod - **Data:** PostgreSQL with PostGIS, Drizzle ORM - **Search & jobs:** Meilisearch, Qdrant, Inngest, Redis-compatible cache - **AI:** LLM-based extraction from unstructured text - **Observability:** Sentry, PostHog, OpenTelemetry You don't need to know all of this on day one. You do need strong TypeScript and React, and the appetite to learn the rest quickly. ### What we're looking for - 0–2 years of experience. Internships, freelance work and serious personal projects all count. - **Strong TypeScript and React.** You're comfortable with components, state, hooks and async data. - **At least one full-stack project you built and shipped,** with a link we can look at. - **Solid SQL basics:** joins, indexes and why a query is slow. - A good grasp of HTTP, APIs and how authentication works. - You use AI coding tools, and you understand everything they produce. - Attention to detail in UI: spacing, states and how a screen feels to use. - You take code review well and learn from it quickly. ### Good to have - Next.js App Router or React Native / Expo experience. - PostgreSQL, Drizzle or another ORM. - Tailwind CSS, animation or design-system work. - Background jobs, maps or search in a past project. - Comfortable in Hindi and English. Our users are brokers across NCR. ### What you'll get - **Close mentorship** from our founding engineer, with every pull request reviewed. - **Real ownership early:** you join before launch, and your features ship in weeks, not quarters. - **A modern stack** across web, mobile, API and AI, in one codebase. - **Equity** in a company at its earliest stage. - **Direct access to the founder:** fast decisions and minimal process. ### This role may not suit you if - You want to work only on frontend or only on backend. - You're looking for a remote role. We work together in person. - You merge AI-generated code you can't explain. ### How we hire 1. Intro call with the founder (20 min). 2. A short practical task (3–4 hours). 3. Pairing session with our founding engineer (60 min): we build or fix something together. 4. Founder conversation, then an offer, usually within two weeks. ### How to apply Wellfound will ask you **"What interests you about working for this company?"** Use that answer to tell us all of the following. Applications that skip them won't be reviewed. 1. **Your GitHub or portfolio**, and one full-stack project you built and shipped, with a live link. 2. **The hardest problem you solved in that project**, and how you solved it. 3. **A time AI-generated code was wrong or misleading**, and how you caught it. 4. **In-office:** confirm you can work from our office in Sector 42, Gurugram, and your notice period or earliest start date. 5. **Your current CTC (or stipend) and your expected CTC.**

Job Title: FP&A / Financial Planning Functional Consultant

Experience: 5+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced FP&A / Financial Planning Functional Consultant to support the design and implementation of modern, integrated financial planning solutions.

The role involves working closely with Finance and business stakeholders to understand existing budgeting and forecasting processes, translate Excel-based financial models into structured planning logic, define functional requirements and support planning transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

FP&A Process & Functional Analysis

• 

Analyze existing budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes.

• 

Understand and document Excel-based planning models, calculations, assumptions and business rules.

• 

Translate offline financial models into structured, system-based planning requirements.

• 

Define functional requirements, planning workflows, business rules and calculation logic.

• 

Work with Finance stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization and automation.

• 

Support both top-down and bottom-up planning approaches.

Financial Planning & Modelling

• 

Support planning models covering Revenue, COGS, Workforce Costs, Property Costs, CapEx, Depreciation, Marketing, IT and Overheads.

• 

Support revenue planning and sales-driven forecasting.

• 

Develop and validate COGS planning based on historical trends, inflation and business assumptions.

• 

Support workforce and payroll-related cost planning.

• 

Support CapEx planning, depreciation calculations and Fixed Asset integration.

• 

Work on percentage-based planning, run-rate planning and campaign/initiative-based planning.

Data & Integration

• 

Work with SAP Finance data including General Ledger, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Entities and Fixed Assets.

• 

Understand integration requirements with HR, sales forecasting and property systems.

• 

Ensure planning models align with underlying financial data dimensions and hierarchies.

• 

Support reporting and analysis across Profit Centers, Cost Centers, GL, Entities and Channels.

Functional Design & Implementation

• 

Define functional designs for financial planning use cases.

• 

Develop and validate planning scenarios and business rules.

• 

Support Proof of Concept activities and validate outputs with Finance stakeholders.

• 

Prepare functional requirements, business rules and functional specifications.

• 

Support UAT, test case definition, validation and business sign-off.

Stakeholder Management

• 

Act as a functional bridge between Finance/business users and technical teams.

• 

Conduct workshops with FP&A, Finance, Accounting and business stakeholders.

• 

Translate financial requirements into functional and system requirements.

• 

Recommend practical improvements to existing processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 

5+ years of experience in FP&A, Financial Planning, Budgeting, Forecasting or Finance Transformation.

• 

Strong understanding of P&L planning, budgeting and forecasting.

• 

Strong knowledge of Revenue, COGS, Opex, Workforce/Payroll Planning, CapEx and Depreciation.

• 

Understanding of Cash Flow and Balance Sheet planning.

• 

Strong financial modelling and analytical skills.

• 

Hands-on experience working with complex Excel-based financial models.

• 

Experience with driver-based and rule-based planning.

• 

Experience working with SAP Finance/SAP data, particularly GL, Cost Center, Profit Center and Fixed Asset data.

• 

Experience in requirements gathering and functional specification preparation.

• 

Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.

• 

Ability to translate Finance/business requirements into functional and system requirements.

• 

Strong understanding of financial hierarchies, dimensions and planning assumptions.

• 

Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good to Have

• 

Experience with SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud Planning, SAP Integrated Planning, Anaplan, OneStream, Oracle EPM, IBM Planning Analytics or similar platforms.

• 

Experience in Finance transformation or planning-system implementation projects.

• 

Experience with retail/store-based financial planning.

• 

Knowledge of workforce planning, payroll modelling, CapEx and Fixed Assets.

• 

Experience integrating planning solutions with SAP and other enterprise systems.

• 

Agile delivery experience.

• 

Experience supporting POCs and solution evaluations.

Keywords

FP&A | Financial Planning | Budgeting | Forecasting | Financial Modelling | SAP Finance | Finance Transformation | P&L Planning | Revenue Planning | COGS | CapEx | Fixed Assets | Financial Analysis | Functional Consultant

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About Out Summer Internship Program

Our Summer Internship Program is designed for students entering their final year of university who are eager to gain meaningful, real-world experience in a fast paced, collaborative, and professional environment.

As a Summer Intern, you'll participate in a comprehensive onboarding experience led by our University Relations team to set you up for success from day one. Throughout the program, you'll also have the opportunity to participate in weekly professional development sessions, networking events, social activities, and other engaging experienced designed to support your personal and professional growth.

The program takes place from June – August 2027 (10-week program).

Your Role 

As a Campaign Marketing Intern, you will support the planning and execution of global marketing programs that drive prospect and customer engagement, sales signals, and pipeline. This role provides hands-on experience in campaign marketing and cross-functional coordination with product marketing, field marketing, execution teams, and agencies. You’ll learn how campaigns come together from strategy to execution, touching everything from messaging and segmentation to digital channels, analytics, and optimization. This internship is ideal for students interested in future roles in campaign marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, or broader gotomarket teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Support 

• Support development of targeted outreach campaigns tied to Veeam’s Go To Market (GTM) framework

• Assist with segmentation lists, project tracking, and campaign performance monitoring

• Create promotional Bill of Materials (BOM) to drive engagement and pipeline for our GTM

• Help ensure messaging aligns with global priorities and audience needs  

Digital Marketing Channels 

• Work closely with Demand Gen execution teams to deliver campaign results, including email marketing, digital advertising, online events, and web

• Shadow execution team meetings to dive deeper into the various execution arms of Demand Gen 

Analytics & Insights  

• Conduct analysis on campaign and segment performance, diving into what is working, not working, and compiling recommendations

• Propose A/B tests and optimizations to help improve performance

• Analyze content and channel patterns and present to campaign leaders 

Qualifications

• Rising Junior or Senior currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving pieces

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint)

• Interest in campaign marketing, digital marketing, or global marketing

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

• Detail-oriented with a proactive, problem-solving mindset 

Benefits

As a paid intern at Veeam, you’ll receive:

• Paid Company Holidays during your internship

• Tech Stipend to help set up your workspace

• 8 Hours of Paid Volunteer Time through our Veeam Cares Program

• Personal and Professional Development through our Internship Program

We’re committed to providing a supportive and rewarding internship experience.

The pay range posted is an hourly rate of base pay. When making an offer of employment, Veeam will take into consideration the candidate’s expectations, experience, education, scope of responsibility for the role, and the current market demands.
